snippet.title: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion | Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
VESSELS: Noiret Mansion
Uncover the mystery of the Noiret family of dollmakers as you explore their abandoned estate.

For years, the story of the Noiret family has been surrounded by rumors and legends. The official version claims that the entire family was murdered by business rivals. Others believe financial troubles and the collapse of their company led to their downfall. Some whisper about darker, supernatural forces at work.

Iris Hale, a young journalist determined to write the article that will make her career, travels to the Noiret Mansion in search of the truth.

What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a dangerous nightmare. The mansion proves far more hostile than expected, and the deeper Iris ventures into its halls, the more she becomes entangled in the secrets of the Noiret family. To uncover the truth, she must survive deadly trials, confront living dolls, and face horrors hidden for decades.

The mansion is not what it seems, and some secrets were never meant to be uncovered.

GAME FEATURES

- Explore the abandoned Noiret Mansion and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls.

- Investigate the tragic fate of Noiret family of dollmakers.

- Encounter living dolls and other horrors lurking throughout the mansion.

- Search for clues, keys, and important items to progress through the mansion.

- Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries connected to the family's dark past.

- Experience a retro-inspired PSX horror aesthetic with atmospheric visuals and sound design.

VESSELS: Noiret Mansion is currently in development. If the project interests you, feel free to follow the studio's social media pages, where I regularly share development updates, behind-the-scenes content, and progress on the game.
